name: test-cat
description: A cross-platform desktop shell for organizing local testing tools.
author: Test cat

scripts.prepare:runtimes: npm run prepare:android-runtime && npm run prepare:ios-runtime
scripts.start: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.preview: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron .
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron . --devtools
scripts.pack: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --dir
scripts.prepare:mac-universal-runtimes: npm run prepare:android-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && npm run prepare:android-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run prepare:ios-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 && npm run prepare:ios-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:mac-universal-runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.build:mac:catalina: npm run prepare:android-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run prepare:ios-runtime -- --platform=darwin --arch=x64 && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.catalina.json --mac --x64
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:android-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run prepare:ios-runtime -- --platform=win32 --arch=x64 && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.win.json --win
scripts.build: npm run prepare:runtimes && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder
